text_en: Hahaah! They've just saved us from being buried alive in one cave and we've ended up in another.
I can't believe we've ended up 'ere. What'll happen to Zarga with half its army gone?
Nasty lookin' place... We 'sposed to start our grand mission somewhere as creepy as 'ere?
If we ain't dead, why've we ended up 'ere? That Valkyrie was talkin' about some power or something like that, right?
There are already several groups of soldiers exploring this cave.
We're getting ready to inspect this area.
This statue thingy makes me all strong again. You feel it too?
If they don't come back in one piece, I don't know if I'll be able to sleep again.
At least the supplies are safe.
I hope you can bring them back safe and sound.
I think spending so long in here is starting to get to me. I could've sworn I heard a pig in the distance.
Stop him! Don't let him hurt them!
Stop worrying about us. I can take care of this. Go.
Let's try to find out what just happened.
What on earth happened to him?
We trust you to free the rest!
That door ahead gives me the creeps.
From your expression, I'd hazard a guess that you've already found all the gems, but I would wipe that smile off my face if I were you.
Look closely. Doesn't that door make your hairs stand on end?_100_ You seem so carefree about this, it makes me nervous.
